security_and_delivery_design: Top-level 'notification' and 'android.notification' are intentionally omitted for private image attachments so Android background delivery wakes SocialFinanceMessagingService (instead of Firebase auto-displaying an unauthenticated text-only duplicate).
Private /api/v1/notifications/images/... URLs are NEVER placed in unauthenticated notification.image or android.notification.image.

Android client downloads data.image_url using Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED> and X-RT-ID headers (live in-memory token in foreground; Android Keystore AES/GCM/NoPadding encrypted cache in background), retaining full RT/RW tenant isolation (unauthenticated GET returns HTTP 401).
iOS still receives native APNs alerts via apns.payload.aps.alert with apns-push-type=alert and apns-priority=10.
